newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag CEO aims for higher return on capital.
newsitem.headline: Viag CEO aims for higher return on capital.

text.p: German utility group Viag AG is aiming for a return on capital employed of 10 percent in three to five years, up from six percent now, chairman Georg Obermeier said on Friday.
In an interview with Reuters Financial Televison, Obermeier also said he was hopeful about a higher dividend.
"I am very optimistic of paying an increased dividend for 1997, but that is not a decision for this year."

Obermeier said Viag plans 5.5 billion marks in investments in 1997, compared to around 5.3 billion marks last year. He said these would be divided half and half between tangible and financial investments.
